tips_summary: Use daily broad-spectrum sunscreen to help prevent further pigmentation, and keep the routine gentle and moisturizing. Introduce active ingredients gradually if desired.

tips.title: Daily protection
points: Apply broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher each morning.
Reapply sunscreen during extended outdoor exposure.

tips.title: Gentle routine
points: Use a moisturizer; introduce a low-strength retinoid gradually if tolerated.

treatment: Maintain a gentle cleansing and moisturizing routine.
Use consistent sun protection to limit the appearance of uneven pigmentation.
Consider a gradual, professionally guided retinoid or brightening routine for texture and tone.
